newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan key 3-month CD rate falls to 0.57 percent.
newsitem.headline: Japan key 3-month CD rate falls to 0.57 percent.

text.p: Japan's key three-month certificate of deposit (CD) rate, the benchmark for the longer end of the money market, fell to 0.57 percent in afternoon Tokyo trade on Monday, its lowest since May 21, traders said.
Around 40 billion yen worth of the CDs was issued. CDs were issued at 0.58 percent on Friday.
Some traders said CD rates could well continue to drift lower, but that 0.55 percent was likely to be the bottom limit, as few people would be interested in buying below that level.
"The speed and scale of the downward drift is also likely to slow from now on," one city bank trader added.
